policies.B1_snr_step4: SNR >= 20 dB -> Step 4, else Step 8 (proposal's SNR-only rule)
policies.P0_proposal_frozen: SNR >= 20 dB and first k in (4,5,6) with d_k <= 0.50, else Step 8
policies.P1_proposal_ltt: as P0, lambda certified by LTT over 0.20, 0.25, ..., 1.20
policies.C1a_probe_gated: SNR >= 20 dB and first k in (4,5,6) with a_k <= lambda; lambda by LTT
policies.C1b_probe_all: first k in (4,5,6) with a_k <= lambda on every prompt; lambda by LTT
policies.C2_joint_restart: gate-passed / gate-failed prompts each get one (k, j); Pareto testing
policies.C3_snr_bands: one step per SNR band [<15, 15-20, 20-30, >=30 dB]; Pareto testing over 256 schedules

protocol.probe: a_k = ||y_hat - x1_hat(t_k)|| / ||x1_hat(t_k)|| over generated frames, y_hat = first student step (tau = 0.0761, the same seeded noise as the real student); higher a_k = riskier (fixed a priori)
protocol.probe_cost: accepted probe reused as the first student step (0 extra NFE); each rejected probe +1 NFE
protocol.threshold_grid: C1: development quantiles q = 0, 0.05, ..., 1 of a_k pooled over steps 4-6 (gated or all prompts), preceded by a no-early-handover value; ordered conservative -> aggressive
protocol.pareto_testing: development: robust risk and NFE of every candidate; keep the Pareto front; order by development risk ascending (ties: higher NFE first), always starting from the Step-8 reference; calibration: fixed-sequence LTT; keep the last certified
protocol.risk: robust per speaker: a speaker fails if either its clean or noisy15 utterance fails

verdict_vs_P0.IMPROVES: certified on calibration, test risk <= alpha, and test mean NFE lower than P0 by more than 0.5
verdict_vs_P0.WORSE: certified, test risk <= alpha, test mean NFE higher than P0 by more than 0.5

protocol.caveat: the test split was inspected in earlier analyses; a winning candidate needs confirmation on fresh speakers
